label: About this form and your privacy
address: 13099 S Cleveland Ave, Suite 310, Fort Myers, FL 33907
notice: When you submit contact details, you ask Culbertson Agency to respond to your enquiry using the information and contact preferences you provide. This notice does not add consent to marketing calls or text messages.
quoteNotice: Quote forms save the information you enter when you select Continue, so our agency team can help even if you do not finish. Submitting a form does not purchase, change or bind insurance coverage.

links.label: Do not sell my personal information

choicesNotice: Manage your contact preferences or send a privacy request through Privacy Choices. Our team reviews these requests; submitting one does not automatically delete records or change your insurance policy.

request.title: Send a privacy request
request.intro: Tell our Fort Myers team what you would like us to review. You may also call (239) 210-7700 or write to the agency address shown below.
request.sensitiveNote: Do not include Social Security numbers, payment card details, medical information, passwords or identity documents in this form.
request.name: Full name *
request.type: What would you like to request? *

types.contact-preferences: Change my contact or marketing preferences
types.do-not-sell: Record my do-not-sell or sharing preference
types.access: Ask about or access my personal information
types.deletion: Request deletion of my personal information

request.authorized: I am making this request about my own information, or I am authorized to act for the person identified. The agency may contact me to verify and process this request.
request.processing: This sends a request to our agency team for review. Applicable law, identity checks and insurance record-retention requirements may affect how we can respond. This is not consent to marketing.
request.successTitle: Your privacy request has been received.
request.successBody: Keep this reference. Our agency team will review your request and may contact you to verify your identity or clarify your instructions.
